text:
sophie: FYI — vendor sync with Gaudi/MI300 + Nvidia teams tomorrow 9:00am PT. Primary goals: announce hooks, thermal/power windows, and fallback routing for H100/H200/B200. Can folks bring preflight checklist items?

arjun: I'll bring the kernel fallback matrix and perf deltas. short bullets only.

marta: I can own embargo/window comms and marketplace tagging.

kevin: hardware rep pinged about B200 power caps in APAC racks — any recent lab numbers? :thinking_face:

dalia: we ran a quick lab sweep last week, PUE and sustained power are in the doc. dropping numbers shortly.

sophie: adding runbook snippet for tomorrow's agenda, please call out anything missing:

```
- slotting_window: 2026-10-12..2026-10-26
- announcement_target: 2026-11-02T15:00Z
- power_budget_watts: H100: 350, H200: 320, MI300: 450, Gaudi: 200, B200: 280
- fallback_chain: primary=H100 -> secondary=H200_quant -> tertiary=Gaudi_fp16
- max_concurrent_jobs: 120 (per-region soft cap)
```

kevin: +1 to the max_concurrent_jobs cap. also request to add a thermal padding flag for APAC racks (+10%).

arjun: heads-up — kernel 1.3.2 regresses at seq=2048 for MI300 in our perf runs. recommend shipping with 1.3.1 for initial slot.

marta: can we keep embargo window to 48h pre-announcement? partners asked for 72h but ops prefers 48h.

sophie: vendor requested a joint press slot on 2026-11-02 15:00Z; legal/PR hold? @dalia can you confirm redaction needs and embargo wording? :eyes:

dalia: legal cleared high-level messaging, need final SKU list + approved images by next Tue. also flagged export control check for MI300 config.

deploy-bot: reminder: create release branch "hw-announce-gaudi-mi300" once SKU list is final. :robot_face:

kevin: one more — SI integrators want a short compatibility matrix for their test harnesses. arjun, can you export the csv?

arjun: will export and attach to meeting notes. format: model, kernel, quant, target_hw, notes.

sophie: perfect. meeting agenda updated and doc link posted: <https://go/repo/announcements/hw-onramp|announce doc> . Bring any last-minute regressions to the start of the call. :thumbsup:

marta: adding a checklist item: coordinate marketplace SKU tag names with partner PMs (avoid internal codenames).

dalia: noted — I'll coordinate partner approvals and get legal sign-off on the embargo phrasing.

sophie: thanks all — see you tomorrow.
